title: Do not parse language representations as JSON
environment: Historical Python/Dify guard. Local/draft correctness does not prove the deployed graph, published version or persisted outputs were repaired.
goal: Accept a generated structured object without discarding valid content.
approach: Historical failed assumption: The guard stringified a dictionary and passed that representation to json.loads.
what_worked: Historical correction: Accept mappings directly and parse only JSON strings. Add parity tests for host and embedded workflow guards. Verification reported by the source: Local contract and embedded-guard tests passed, and the fix was present in a draft. The latest recorded live attempt stopped upstream at HTTP 401; existing records were not regenerated and end-to-end recovery was unverified.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: Every audited record used whole-output safety fallback despite a valid generated object.
why: Confirmed: language dictionary notation is not JSON text; valid object input was misclassified.
improved_method: Branch on the actual input type at serialization boundaries. Test object and string forms, and measure fallback frequency so safe degradation does not conceal systematic rejection.
when_to_use: Historical Python/Dify guard. Local/draft correctness does not prove the deployed graph, published version or persisted outputs were repaired.
when_not_to_use: Local/draft correctness does not prove the deployed graph, published version or persisted outputs were repaired.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
